subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` become a supported after-compaction plugin contract, limited to contexts with an explicit lifecycle owner that can safely drain the reset after active work exits?
rationale: This adds a public plugin capability that rotates persisted session state and requires a permanent ownership rule across OpenClaw, Codex, Copilot, context-engine, gateway, reply, memory, follow-up, and cron paths; implementation review cannot choose that API contract without session/runtime owner intent.

options.title: Approve lifecycle-owned API
options.body: Approve the narrow API only where a caller-owned queue guarantees post-run draining, and withhold it everywhere else until that ownership is available.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Do not add a plugin hook API; keep session rotation in core-owned recovery and explicit command/gateway surfaces.

options.title: Design a broader plugin API
options.body: Pause this PR and define a general session lifecycle capability with explicit permissions, completion semantics, and compatibility documentation.

recommendation.title: Approve lifecycle-owned API
recommendation.body: Approve the narrow API only where a caller-owned queue guarantees post-run draining, and withhold it everywhere else until that ownership is available.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest available history signal across the hook contract and adjacent agent runtime boundaries.
